cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

mechanism: A wins a narrow acknowledgment and assumes the authority to interpret its logic as grounds for a broader claim.
confusable: Distinguish simply asking for more from using the reason or substance conceded in B2 to weaken B later boundary.
comparison: Plant guest permission becomes a principle for more windowsill space; paragraph acknowledgment becomes a claim to the argument running through the speech.
seedUse: Use canonical plant and speech seeds; S01 controls interpretation after the small concession, with concrete objects and claims rather than abstract audience language.
